title: Raku Glazing Events or At-Home Raku Parties
source_quote: Join us for Raku Glazing Events or book your at-home party, we will come to you!
evidence_sentence: VR Pottery OBX offers raku firing as a rental service for at-home parties or scheduled public glazing events where participants glaze bisque pieces and watch the raku firing.
evidence_quote: We bring the kiln and all the necessary materials for us to fire your piece.
summary: VR Pottery OBX offers raku firing as a service: either book an at-home raku party ($700 for their vacation/wedding package) where they bring the kiln, or attend a scheduled public glazing event (no experience needed). Participants glaze pre-made bisque pieces and watch the firing.
bring: bisque pottery pieces are provided; participants bring tables, chairs, workspace, water, and optional refreshments
cost_text: OBX Vacation and Wedding Package: $700 (4 hours with 14 pieces and 2 firings); additional 2 hours: $250
how_to_join: Book a party via the contact form on the Raku Events page, or check back for scheduled public events
commitment: 90 minutes to glaze, approximately 2 hours total for public event
pay_text: $700 OBX Vacation and Wedding Package; $250 for additional 2 hours
